purpose: Declarative regression definitions for migration; not an executable runner, allowlist or PASS attestation. Point 2 consumes these into unified tests, domain points implement scenarios and point 10 executes broad acceptance.
execution_policy: No automatic invocation derived from this file. Mutating and private helper cases require explicit isolated fixture setup.

scenarios.assertions: Pass spaces, shell metacharacters and embedded newlines as literal argv; no shell expansion. Inject child exit 7 where the adapter promises native propagation.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: fake-process; real adapter subprocess in final verification

scenarios.assertions: Resolve tools by launcher root, retain distinct target repository for hooks; customer receipt never enables owner scope. Exercise host, devcontainer, unrelated cwd and path with spaces.

Assert the per-surface help/error matrix in README. Argparse parse failure is 2; string SystemExit is 1; preserve other documented native codes. Do not assume every internal fixture supports --help or invoke its no-argument mode generically.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: fake effects; external subprocess only after fixture setup

scenarios.assertions: Explicit --plan returns a preview bound to null request id without dispatch, locks, operation receipts or Docker lifecycle effects. Cold discovery may use the isolated existing management artifact as documented.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: recording process runner; prepared management artifact

scenarios.assertions: Repeated --group and --all retain exact graph/prerequisites, exclusions and hash; invalid combinations refuse before mutation; customer has no owner roadmap requirement.
Restore signals and stable locks; terminate/reap process groups; interrupted coordinator and surviving children cannot be mistaken for PASS or overwritten evidence.
Inspect actual staged blobs, reject secret/env/key and invalid message; preserve partial staging and nondefault index; retain receipt role and knowledge freshness; never auto-index inside a hook.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: isolated Git repositories and synthetic nonsecret fixtures

scenarios.assertions: Retain model/dimension/input limits, pending manifests, no mixed embedding space, branch/parser/source freshness, deterministic chunks and golden filters; injected owner additions never enter customer corpus.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: fakes first; isolated collections for final live scenarios

scenarios.assertions: Direct diagnostics and quality share results; lock/image identity mismatch and scanner failure remain nonzero; collect remaining selected reports and redact payloads; actual review evidence is required.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: fake scanner plus isolated exact-image scan in final point

scenarios.assertions: Build/deploy exact customer source/images, forward data only, preserve maintenance/recovery fencing and refuse unsafe rollback; no tooling/AI in runtime artifacts.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: owned customer simulation; no existing deployment

scenarios.assertions: Ordinary setup/reopen does not migrate/seed; explicit initialization does; application readiness remains independent of optional AI failures.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: fake process and isolated customer fixture

scenarios.assertions: Refuse duplicate, unknown, oversized or mismatched request fields, foreign identity and source mismatch before effects; preserve disconnected receipts, cancellation and recovery.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: private test transport and fake Docker

scenarios.assertions: Exercise verified acquisition/reference projection and explicit customer remote; external bundle without maintainer code; 0.5.0 to 0.6.0 upgrade preserves application/custom guidance and forbidden paths stay absent.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: separate customer repositories and complete reviewed external bundle

scenarios.assertions: Interrupt source replacement and committed data transitions; resume exact approved identity/journal without replay or resetting pending state; preserve credentials and durable evidence.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: failure-injected filesystem/runtime then final isolated host acceptance

scenarios.assertions: Retain extracted argument grammar and exact caller protocol; library imports become inert; unsafe internal direct invocation must not be promoted to a public command. Executable tests retain meaningful scenarios under pytest discovery.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: source contract; suitable isolated fixtures, never generic no-arg invocation

scenarios.assertions: Retain suite lock, guarded inactive runa_test_test_N cleanup, base runa_test preservation and automatic browser label/journal ownership; cleanup only exact task-created resources and reap children first.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: isolated test resources with explicit ownership

scenarios.assertions: Compare projected source/wheel/bundle contents; customer works physically without owner/distribution; external works outside checkout; runtime has no Python tooling or AI.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: isolated projections and package installs outside source cwd

scenarios.assertions: Use distinct operator/release roots and TLS overlays in one interpreter; production source/data failures retain fencing and native exits; rollback refuses unproven data compatibility.
scenarios.existing_evidence: contracts/test_deployment_services.py; native production/installation harnesses (pending migrated fixture reconciliation)
scenarios.fixture_requirements: injected services now; isolated native production project in final verification

scenarios.assertions: Acquire an independently verified 0.5.0 installation and exact 0.6.0 candidate; preserve customer Python config/tests/frozen inputs and reconcile shared defaults with exact consent. Interrupt source/data boundaries and resume without replaying committed effects. Verify initial installation with each release matching installer/gateway.
scenarios.fixture_requirements: injected original/target projections now; real customer/Git/Compose/PHP/database/toolchain acceptance in point 10
